name: Print House Ltd
notes: Paul approved quality. Used for both standard BR tees and poster tees. Clara visited warehouse in person multiple times. They suggested switching from DTG to DTF (cheaper, looks better, lasts as long). Always get a DTF sample before committing to bulk.
turnaround: 7-14 days for samples, 14-21 days for bulk. DTF orders can be ready 'by next week'.

orders_completed.note: Switched from DTG to DTF at Print House recommendation. $107/tee (DTF) vs $151/tee (DTG black).

key_events: Clara visited warehouse multiple times for sample pickup
Off-centre poster print on one sample — quality inconsistency flagged
Henry's custom tee was comped (Print House felt bad about poster error)
Print House proactively suggested DTF switch — good partner behaviour

pricing.note: Current pricing is LOWER than 2022. DTF recommended. Sliding scale — more units = cheaper. No minimum order per website. Bulk pricing from 50+.

design_variants_on_file.note: Children's sizes available, same price as adult. Good for summer camps.
